That's a solid core flow locked in. Let me do a quick **overall check** before I record it and we move on.

Here's everything we've settled so far, in plain terms:

**Saving**
- Paste a link and save; the app auto-fills the title, description, page icon, and a preview image, and you can correct any of them.
- Add tags (comma-separated) with suggestions from tags you already use, so you don't create near-duplicate tags; picking an existing tag reuses it exactly regardless of capitalization.
- Add a longer personal note with simple formatting (bold, bullet lists, safe links).

**Finding**
- One search box that filters live as you type, case-insensitive, across title, description, note, address, and tags.
- Click a tag to filter to it; `#tag` matches that exact tag; `"quotes"` for an exact phrase; combine with `AND` / `OR` / `NOT` and parentheses; a word next to a tag means both; quoting a word like `"and"` treats it as text.

**Duplicates & editing**
- Saving an address you already have doesn't create a copy — it warns and offers to open the existing one for editing. "Same address" ignores domain capitalization, `www.`, and a trailing slash, but treats a different path capitalization as a different page.
- Every card has an Edit button; you can change the address, title, description, tags, and note, and it updates in place. Changing an address to one that already exists is blocked. No force-duplicate option.

**Do all of these match your intent?** If yes, I'll record this as our settled baseline, and then — before we talk about building it for real — I'd like to walk through a few **"what happens when…" situations** (like an empty collection, a link whose page can't be read, a huge list) so we don't get surprised later.
